bootoptions.description: List of default boot options (strings) to add. Use %flavour in values to expand to flavour name.

remove_bootoptions.description: List of boot options (regex allowed) to remove from existing options.

grub_mbr.description: If true, install GRUB to MBR instead of PBR.

fat16.description: If true, format target partition with FAT16 (destroys existing data).

force.description: If true, skip interactive confirmation for destructive actions.

mbr_menu.description: If true, install MBR with integrated boot menu.

skip_bootflag.description: If true, skip verification of boot flag on target device.

skip_grub_config.description: If true, skip generation of GRUB configuration files.

skip_mbr.description: If true, skip installation or modification of MBR.

skip_syslinux_config.description: If true, skip generation of SYSLINUX configuration files.

skip_usb_check.description: If true, skip check verifying device is removable.

syslinux_mbr.description: If true, install syslinux' MBR instead of default MBR.

isos.description: List of paths to Grml ISO files or /run/live/medium. First entry is default boot entry.

device.description: Target device (e.g., /dev/sdX1) or directory. If directory, no bootloader is installed.
